overview_description.description:
Superagent.com is the rebranded version of deepsky.ai. 

The company's original name was Gradient. Gradient rebranded as Deepsky. And then, Deepsky rebranded as Superagent.

about_short_description.short_description: Superagent is a software development company that delivers software solutions to enable customer support through an innovative helpdesk.

product.name: Superagent Website Chat Solution
product.description: A customizable website chat software tailored for hosting providers to enable customer support and communication.

product.name: Snippets
product.description: Pre-written text blocks that agents can quickly insert into conversations using keyboard shortcuts to save time and maintain consistent communication.

product.name: AI-powered Customer Support
product.description: An AI feature using large language models to assist in answering customer requests automatically or support agents during interactions.

product.name: Superagent Desktop and Mobile Apps
product.description: Branded desktop and mobile applications that provide access to Superagent’s customer support platform across devices.

product.name: Multi-Channel Communication Support
product.description: A platform feature enabling customer support through various channels including email, website chat, WhatsApp, SMS, and Facebook Messenger.

product.name: Conversation Blocks
product.description: Reusable conversation segments including intros, bodies, and closings that help agents maintain consistent communication and improve efficiency.
